{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
non_numeric_count = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of non-numeric values in 'revenue': {non_numeric_count}")

# Check the first few converted values
df[['revenue', 'revenue_numeric']].head()"}
